findings.edge: Drop Inference without invoking the deferred closure
findings.evidence: FencedOwner is constructed before Inference::Deferred and is the only closure capture. Drop calls wait; on success finish retires resources then releases the lease; on failure fail_closed quarantines the lease and forgets all resources. Test dropping_inference_without_completion_fences_before_resource_drop asserts wait -> retire -> resource_drop.

launch/record errors return through the same owner Drop. partial_enqueue_then_failed_fence_retains_all_owners asserts wait -> quarantine and no resource_drop. HostIoLease::quarantine closes the I/O pool and leaks the pinned slot; model/request/workspaces are forgotten together.

submit calls pack_batch before the pooled/raw empty shortcut. malformed_media_with_zero_selectors_is_still_rejected builds a zero-selector Batch with a bad pixel payload and requires the typed payload error. No lease or ticket is acquired.
The closure captures one FencedOwner. No separate model/request/workspace/lease captures exist, so capture order cannot free resources before the fence.

Health returns Unhealthy if the I/O pool is poisoned, then synchronizes the stream. Submission binds the context once; forward_outputs_with does not bind; FA4 uses forward_batch_bound; LT/RoPE calls do not bind. A failed fence closes the pool and retains owners.

WorkspaceCache tracks retained bytes against cache::BYTE_BUDGET, drops oversized fenced workspaces, trims free fenced workspaces and returns Overloaded before allocating beyond budget. workspace_byte_budget_fails_before_allocating_another_owner covers the guard.

findings.edge: Request-path hidden stream synchronize / host upload
findings.evidence: review/ASYNC-UPLOAD-AUDIT.json: weights use pinned WeightUploader async H2D with event retention; VisionWork/PositionWork own pinned host pixel/row/frame/rope tables and copy_prefix enqueues async H2D from them; decoder metadata uses the request pinned HostIo input; output uses memcpy_dtoh_async into pinned output. No request-path DeviceBuffer::from_host. Only load-time decoder rope tables use from_host.

findings.edge: Third same-thread submit with two held Deferred owners
findings.evidence: Normal Backend serving keeps blocking SlotPool::acquire per Root policy. BackendThread producer hands Deferred work to the dedicated CompletionThread, so completion releases a slot while the producer waits. Direct low-level same-thread callers must complete or drop one of two held owners before the third submit; this is documented, not converted to try_acquire/429. No public try_submit was added.

findings.edge: Multi-image pinned source rewritten before prior async H2D fence
findings.evidence: VisionWork pre-stages every image/frame list into disjoint immutable pinned regions using plan_pinned_staging before the first H2D; run loops over disjoint slices. CPU tests assert disjoint ranges, exact totals, bad payload and overflow rejection.
pack_batch validates merge_size/grid with checked arithmetic before token-count division; real CPU test returns typed error without panic.
pack_batch rejects any non-empty media.audios before images/positions and before the empty-selector shortcut; real CPU test asserts typed audio rejection.

findings.edge: Pinned arena sized/accounted per max image while plan spans request totals
findings.evidence: VisionWork::new now allocates host_pixels/host_frames from key.staged_pixels/key.staged_frames via pinned_staging_capacities; bytes accounting charges totals. CPU test compares multi-image plan totals against capacity and proves capacity exceeds max-image sizes. Device pixels/frame_offsets remain max-sized and stream-ordered.

findings.edge: Config-inconsistent descriptor accepted on zero-selector path
findings.evidence: prepare_batch validates media against loaded config patch_dim/merge_size before the empty-selector Ready. CPU tests cover patch_dim 0/empty pixels, patch_dim 4/16 pixels, and merge_size 4/config 2 with zero selectors.
validate_selectors rejects out-of-range, duplicate, and mixed pooled/raw selections before lease/ticket. CPU test exercises all four cases.

findings.evidence: forward_batch now uses prepare_batch (pack + config media + selectors) before its empty shortcut.
